name: Danazol
description: A synthetic attenuated androgen derived from ethisterone, approved for endometriosis, fibrocystic breast disease and hereditary angioedema. It suppresses pituitary gonadotropin output.

systems.note: Suppression of gonadotropin-driven gonadal steroidogenesis is the intended effect.
Gonadotropin suppression is the mechanism but the pituitary is not the therapeutic target.
Boxed warning for peliosis hepatis and hepatic adenoma.
Boxed warning for thromboembolism; adverse lipid shift is labelled.
